assumptions.statement: Overall and three key-area polygons are organizer-maintained provisional rough geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, figure positions and station anchors must be recalculated after official GIS/CAD is released.

assumptions.statement: The three station points are conceptual anchors inside rough key-area boxes; no tenure, building, fire, accessibility, utilities or footfall survey has been completed.
assumptions.impact: They cannot be used as a site-selection, construction or procurement decision.

assumptions.statement: The 90-day pilot, three-node replication and operating roles are candidate mechanisms, not confirmed government actions, investments or partnerships.
assumptions.impact: Advance only through explicit responsibility, safety, inclusion and maintainability gates.

assumptions.statement: The public-service agent uses curated public knowledge, source links and aggregate service logs; face recognition and default biometric collection are excluded.
assumptions.impact: Any later data expansion requires necessity review, notice, minimization, retention and human appeal design.

assumptions.statement: No capital or operating budget is asserted before a verified site, bill of quantities and operator plan exist.
assumptions.impact: Cost remains an explicit data gap rather than an invented number.
